hero.caption: Aerial photograph I took myself of Ballenas Islands in the Strait of Georgia. Ballenas Light is on the top Island of the pair in the foreground.  You can then see Sangster, then Lasqueti and then Texada Islands in the background.  These islands are in the Straits of Georgia between Vancouver Island and mainland British Columbia, Canada.  This photo is taken facing North.
